comments.author: Blake.C
comments.body:
*re-posting the info I made when I pulled this wreck a year ago*

Pulled it at 13218,2801 just east of North America East landing point. Required R6 Recognition. I got these

Bow Pedrero
82 Gold
87 Ignis Solution
125 Fine Clothing
Salvager Bicorne
Western Boots
90 European Armour
17 Master's Repair Tools

It also has the chance to drop the very rare Pirate's Sword although it's a not given as I found out.
